claimed_scope: Define the minimal deferred causal-return envelope that turns an already result-bound F2-WP-102 NativeChildBinding into an explicit causal re-entry identity for the semantic parent agent/task. This package defines return/re-entry provenance only. It does not implement recipient delivery/ACK/transport attempts (F2-WP-103), execution success/failure/completion semantics (F2-WP-105), child spawning/runtime (F2-WP-601+), UnifiedDB persistence, effects, or VPS execution.
non_overlap_note: Exact-head claim inventory contained no F2-WP-104 claim. F2-WP-103 owns recipient/delivery/ACK/transport-attempt lifecycle and is not modified here.
return_invariants: a deferred return may be formed only from a NativeChildBinding with an immutable result_id/result_sha256 already bound
return_id is explicit and independent of result_id, delegation_id, causal_id and transport identity
resume.parent_causal_id equals the child causal_id, making child result re-entry causal rather than temporal coincidence
resume generation is strictly greater than child generation
resume session_id equals the parent session_id and resume agent_id/task_id equal the semantic parent agent/task
no wall-clock time, process identity, recipient ACK or delivery attempt is used to infer causal return identity
serialization is deterministic and malformed/unknown fields fail closed
acceptance_target: typed deferred-return envelope binds return_id + result-bound child binding + explicit parent re-entry CausalIdentity
unbound child results cannot be returned
wrong parent causal linkage, stale generation, wrong parent agent/task or implicit session bridge are rejected
deterministic serialization/hash and strict mapping are tested
component tests do not mint runtime/whole-system credit
